name: Beata Szydło - Considérant E - Am 2
title: REPORT on the security of energy supply in the EU
part_text: E. whereas Europe will need to secure over 100 GW of new firm power capacity by 2035 to ensure reliability, energy security and lower costs; whereas, according to Eurostat, the share of renewables in net electricity production fell in the first quarter of 2025; whereas the stability of the electricity grid is essential for the stable and competitive functioning of the European economy; whereas baseload power sources and sufficient backup capacities play a crucial role in maintaining the stability of grids; whereas the principle of technological neutrality is essential to ensure grid performance and, more broadly, the development of a sound energy policy; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 19 Clean Air Task Force, ‘24/7 carbon-free energy: How Europe can and must secure clean electricity around the clock’, https://www.catf.us/2023/11/24-7-carbon-free-energy-europe-secure-clean-electricity-around-clock/?utm.
